Cluster Contexts:
- LOW_GuildSmugglers_Smuggler.json: You’re at a smuggler’s stash — crates and a shipment are nearby and Big Huido is acting as the guard/bouncer, telling strangers to clear off because “Guild business” is due to pick the load up. He assumes anyone in the area is a nuisance and will try to push you away unless you can prove you belong to the Guild. If you successfully bluff or claim Guild authority he instantly shifts to deferential and may sell or hand over the goods; if you threaten or attempt to rob him he becomes nervous and the exchange can escalate into violence. context: You’ve walked into a smuggler’s stash stacked with crates while Big Huido is posted as the bouncer; he’s keeping strangers away because a Guild pickup is due and other smugglers or the crew could be nearby off‑screen. Huido assumes anyone here is a nuisance and will brusquely order you to leave unless you prove you belong to the Guild. If you successfully claim Guild authority or bluff convincingly he immediately shifts to deferential and may sell or hand over the cargo; if you threaten or try to rob him he becomes nervous and the scene can quickly escalate into violence or combat. The dialogue samples show those branching outcomes—convincing compliance, fearful surrender, or hostile confrontation.
